patches.title: Countertop Numeric Order
patches.principle: When searching for an object, visit countertops in ascending numeric order (1,2,3...).
patches.when_to_apply: When target object is not immediately visible and countertops exist.

patches.title: Avoid Bathroom Furniture
patches.principle: Ignore bathroom-specific furniture like handtowelholder and toiletpaperhanger when searching for items to clean.
patches.when_to_apply: When clean task starts and bathroom furniture is present.

patches.title: No Actions After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, perform no actions other than transformation and placement until goal is complete.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just picked up the task object and are holding it.
